articles.title: 'Difficult to Overstate' Volatility of White House AI Messaging, Says Greg Allen
articles.summary: Greg Allen, Founder and CEO of Decision Tree Research and former AI strategy official at the Department of Defense, said that it is 'extremely difficult to overstate' how volatile the Trump administration's messaging has been on artificial intelligence regulations as it swings between dismissing AI safety fears and requiring mandatory regulations. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Schwab CEO on AI Strategy, Investing Trends, and ‘Charlie’
articles.summary: Rick Wurster, president and CEO at The Charles Schwab Corporation, discusses customer trends in investing, efforts to attract younger investors, and why the firm is blocking unauthorized AI agents. He speaks on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Apple to Release AI Platform in Mainland China
articles.summary: Apple is planning to launch Apple Intelligence in mainland China in December. This is a huge market for the company. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman broke the news and has more on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
